findings.finding: A seventh living scenario is false after this change and is not in the delta. "A bar in a cell with room" (living 878-881) configures `context` with the format `$percent $bar` and no label in a 20-column cell and states "the rest of the format takes 6 of them" and "the bar occupies the 14 columns". With `Context:` declared, the label and gap take 9 more, the bar gets 5. The matching test is already in the 38 (first pass: `Context: [░]` where `[████░░░░░░]` was expected). Decision 7's list of six was my first-pass list, which came from a grep for model text; it is presented as complete without the search that produced it. The search: every living WHEN configuring model, path, context, tokens or cost with a format and no label gives 11 lines (702, 741, 747, 774, 786, 879, 925, 930, 937, 967, 1270); 702, 747, 967 and 1270 state no exact text or width and stay true; the other seven need the rule.
